body: Paramjit Singh Soni (Promoter, Executive Director & Vice-Chairman) on the Q4FY25 call (2025-05-28), volunteered: "We expect to sustain free cash flow generation at levels consistent with FY 2025 on a quarterly basis" Metric: Free cash flow per quarter FY26. Target: ~FY25 pace (FY25 FCF ~INR 152 cr). Deadline: 2026-03-31 (fiscal-year). Specificity: range. Status as of 2026-11-19: DELIVERED. Evidence: FY26 FCF INR 148 cr vs FY25 INR 152 cr (screener), 97%, despite revenue +21% and tariff working-capital drag.
